metrics.summary: In src/click/types.py, FuncParamType.convert now catches the ValueError as `exc` and, if it has a non-empty message, calls `self.fail(str(exc), param, ctx)` so the user sees the helpful message (e.g. "Invalid value for '--port': port must be between 1 and 65535"). A message-less ValueError still falls back to reporting the offending value, decoded as UTF-8 with replacement if `str()` fails on bytes. Verified with a manual repro (both with and without a message) and the full test suite (1307 passed, 1 xfailed).
